data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'symeon', meaning 'God's little one' or 'revered one'. In the New Testament, the name Symeon is given to two significant characters: a righteous man who sees the baby Jesus in the temple and a prophet who blesses the child. The name Syman carries the meaning “God's little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Syman usually hope their child will grow to embody god's little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Syman total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
